title: Ukrainian-inspired Vegan Terrine with Graham Cracker Crust
description: A unique and earthy vegan terrine recipe, featuring a rich graham cracker crust and a nourishing, plant-based filling.
instructions: Crush the graham crackers and mix them with a pinch of salt. Press the mixture into the bottom of a terrine mold.
In a separate pan, sauté the coconut oil and dried dill weed over low heat for 2 minutes.
Add the mushroom broth and wild rice to the pan, and bring to a simmer. Cook until the rice is tender.
Stir in the Ukrainian-style vegan sour cream, and season with salt to taste.
Pour the filling over the graham cracker crust in the terrine mold.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the filling is set and the crust is golden brown.
Let the terrine cool completely before serving.
